property_summary: For every successful Collect, the caller's balance either decreases by exactly the amount collected, or if the transfer fails, the transaction reverts; the buggy version instead lets the balance decrease while still logging even when the transfer fails, so the stored balance becomes inconsistent with that guard and the logged amount.
change_summary: Change the external call success guard to always run the log update regardless of call success, so failed value transfers do not revert.
